name: manual_382756
claim: When two implementations of the same task exist, reconcile by pinned tests: synthesize the canonical version from the one that passes every pinned test, mark the other superseded without reverting it, and re-derive stacked work on the synthesized base.

decisions.notes: Two interim cleanup-fence implementations were compared: one failed a pinned retry-count behaviour test and carried out-of-scope additions with stacked work inheriting the failure; the other passed thirty-six tests including the pinned characterization.

rationale: Two interim cleanup-fence implementations were compared: one failed a pinned retry-count behaviour test and carried out-of-scope additions with stacked work inheriting the failure; the other passed thirty-six tests including the pinned characterization.
